verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's 'Agent' mode explicitly accepts natural-language prompts (e.g., 'Update the website to allow searching for running races by name') and autonomously analyzes the codebase and generates multi-file edits, and Copilot chat can be asked in plain English to refactor code. This directly demonstrates natural-language command operation across coding tasks. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of agent-mode reliability beyond vendor docs, and evidence NL commands extend to non-coding GitHub surfaces (issues/PRs/project management) rather than just Copilot chat/agent.
